profile.name: Yowkey
profile.headline: Android engineer building with Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Multiplatform
profile.summary: I design and ship mobile apps end to end: architecture, UI that feels fast, and the release pipeline behind it. This site is itself a Compose Multiplatform app compiled to WebAssembly.
profile.availability: Open to freelance and full-time roles

services.title: Android app development
services.description: Native Android apps in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, from first screen to Play Store release.

services.title: Kotlin Multiplatform
services.description: One Kotlin codebase for Android, iOS, desktop and web, with Compose Multiplatform UI where it fits.

services.title: Performance and UI polish
services.description: Finding jank, slow startup and wasted recomposition, and fixing it with traces to prove it.

services.title: Architecture and code review
services.description: Clean layering, dependency injection with Koin, coroutines and Flow done right, and tests that catch regressions.

projects.title: The Eagle's Watch
projects.summary: A civic transparency app that lists Philippine public infrastructure projects with their contracts, schedules, reported progress and source documents, so citizens can check what public money is building.
highlights: Search and filter by status, place, agency, contractor and contract size, with live counts
Every figure labelled with how it was established; every record has a report path
One Compose Multiplatform codebase for Android, iOS and the web

projects.title: BubuProtect
projects.summary: A personal security vault for Android: passwords and TOTP codes behind biometrics and face recognition, plus a scan of the device for risks.
highlights: Biometric unlock with a face-recognition second factor
Device risk scan to flag an unsafe environment

projects.title: This portfolio
projects.summary: A Compose Multiplatform app running in your browser through Kotlin/WebAssembly, with a crawlable HTML version generated from the same content at build time.
highlights: Adaptive layout from phone to wide desktop using window size classes
Content lives in one JSON file shared by the app and the generated HTML
Built, tested and deployed to GitHub Pages by GitHub Actions
